_status: Relaxed on the owner's request (2026-11-16): not strict. Everything is allowed except what breaks the render or the review.
allow: Latin letters, including accented ones (Archivo ships a Latin subset)
all punctuation, including typographic quotes, dashes and the ellipsis
math and currency symbols (+ % = Rp-style prices)
forbid: emoji and pictographic symbols: they break the style (the original Gemini failure)
invisible and control characters, combining marks, variation selectors, and non-ASCII spaces: a human cannot see them in review
letters of other scripts: they render in a fallback font, which also stops homoglyph tricks
the markup characters * _ ~: the renderer reads them as tone markers
